messages:
alex: Heads-up — noticed a couple of customers seeing extra token charges when a deferred toolcall returns after the stream was truncated. Repro steps below, wanted quick sync before I file a proper issue.

mira: oof, can you paste logs or an example trace id?

alex: minimal snippet:
```
INFO trace=t1234 stream_sent=20 truncated=true 
INFO trace=t1234 toolcall_complete tokens_charged=28 toolcall_nonce=nc-7 
LEDGER write: session=ps-789 tokens=20 provisional
LEDGER write: session=ps-789 tokens=28 confirmed
```
Looks like we end up charging both the truncated stream (20) and the toolcall (28) instead of deduping the overlap/padding.

sam: is this specific to deferred toolcalls (where the tool finishes after the client saw EOF)?

alex: yes, deferred toolcall + padding enabled. Also happens if the router retries and the toolcall arrives on a different path (new trace id), so simple trace dedupe isn't enough.

devex-jess: console/UX question: customers see a final invoice delta and panic. Can we show a "pending toolcall" indicator or estimated extra tokens so it's less surprising? :thinking_face: 

mira: telemetry: we should add a metric for suffix toolcall delta (toolcall_tokens - stream_suffix_tokens) and tag by region + routing_policy. That'll help correlate.

sam: for accounting change: options I can think of — 1) dedupe by parent_session_id + nonce within a grace window, 2) mark stream tokens provisional until toolcall settles, 3) subtract overlapping tokens on toolcall finalization. Each has tradeoffs for complexity/consistency.

alex: quick preference: (1) parent_session_id + toolcall_nonce dedupe within 30s grace window. We already store parent_session on most ledgers, and nonce exists for toolcalls. Fallback: subtract overlap on finalize if we can compute overlap reliably.

devex-jess: UX: If you go with provisional stream tokens, console should surface provisional vs confirmed tokens per route and allow toggling 'include provisional' in cost previews. That prevents surprise.

mira: agree. Also add an eval alert rule that fires on per-account sudden delta > 15% between provisional and confirmed tokens for 5m.

sam: caveat: retries that create new parent_session_ids break the dedupe. We need the router to propagate an origin_id that survives retries, or map session_handoff events.

alex: noted. I'll open a router PR to attach origin_id to handoffs, then ledger change to dedupe on origin_id+nonce. We'll gate via feature flag and run canary.

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-31415 — "Deferred toolcall double-charge (padding overlap)". Assigned to @alex.

sam: timeline proposal: PRs this week, unit+integration tests with simulated truncation/retry harness, feature-flag rollout to canary accounts next Tue, monitor telemetry for 72h, then global rollback/rollout as needed.

devex-jess: @alex pls add a docs blurb and console mock for the provisional toggle — I'll own the changelog entry.

alex: will do. I'll draft PRs and a small test harness to simulate stream->truncate->deferred-toolcall with routing retries. Plan: canary flag name `ledger_toolcall_dedupe_v1`.

ops-bot: Deploy queued: deploy/ledger-dedupe_v0.3 -> canary (job #1234). Logs will post here on completion. :rocket:

mira: thanks — once deployed, I'll wire the new metric and set the alert.

alex: cheers, we'll follow up with actual numbers after canary.
